## PATCH `/api/2.29/workloads`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modifies a workload by renaming or destroying it. To rename a workload, set `name` to the new name. To destroy a workload, set `destroyed=true`. To recover a workload that has been destroyed and is pending eradication, set `destroyed=false`. The `ids` or `names` parameter is required, but they cannot be set together.

| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |

| `names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique resource names specified. Only one value is supported. |

**Request body** (required): `WorkloadPatch`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `destroyed` | boolean | If set to `true`, destroys a resource. Once set to `true`, the `time_remaining` value will display the amount of time left until the destroyed resource is permanently eradicated. Before the `time_remaining` period has… |
| `name` | string | The new name for the resource. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `WorkloadResponse`

## DELETE `/api/2.29/workloads`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes a workload that has been destroyed and is pending eradication. Eradicated workloads cannot be recovered. Workloads are destroyed using the `PATCH` method. The `ids` or `names` parameter is required, but they cannot be set together.

**Responses:** `200` OK
